method: Ground-truth tube Gaussians of case 121_0 (Step 1.1 centerline + stenosed radius, 0.5 mm spacing) filled with the true concentration c(s, t_j) of the Step 1.2 bolus, projected with flowsplat.model.ConeProjector under 32 conventions (s_theta in +-1, theta0 in 0/90/180/270 deg, s_u in +-1, s_v in +-1) and compared with the TIGRE renders of Step 1.2 (relative L2 error)
note: Remaining error: Gaussian versus uniform-disk cross-section profile and the clipped detector noise floor (positive mean, also in contrast-free frames). Frames without contrast (frame 10) are not informative.
